title: Nginx fuzzing defect register
grouping: Crash artifacts are grouped by root cause; slow findings are excluded because repeated delays of 61, 84, and 73 ms did not establish a persistent hang.

defects.module: nginx core I/O (ngx_write_file) and HTTP request-body temp-file path
defects.sanitizer_type: UBSan: applying zero offset to null pointer (null pointer arithmetic); no ASan report in this finding group
defects.methodology_type: Некорректная обработка длин буферов с данными

weakness_mapping.name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
weakness_mapping.rationale: The source evaluates buf + written when buf is NULL and written is zero; this is undefined behavior in the instrumented C build.

input_vector.trigger: Chunked request-body processing reaches a zero-size temp-file write; the code still forms buf + written with a NULL buffer.

defects.comment: A zero-size write is accompanied by undefined pointer arithmetic. Available logs show no read or write through the pointer, buffer overflow, or memory corruption. This is a genuine correctness/UB finding, but exploitability is not demonstrated.

classification.label: истинный дефект
classification.basis: UBSan reliably detects the source-level undefined behavior; the absence of a crash without sanitizers does not make the finding false-positive.

remediation.recommended_action: Avoid forming a pointer for a zero-length write, or ensure a valid buffer before pointer arithmetic and the write call.

fixed_code_retest.result: Not applicable: neither a source fix nor a compensating measure has been applied. Existing non-sanitized and optimized replays use the unfixed code.

defects.sanitizer_type: UBSan: nonnull-attribute violation (NULL passed to a nonnull copy argument); no ASan report in this finding group

weakness_mapping.name: Function Call with Incorrectly Specified Arguments
weakness_mapping.rationale: A NULL source is passed to the URI-copy operation for a zero-length path, contrary to the nonnull argument contract. No actual NULL dereference was observed, so CWE-476 is not claimed.

input_vector.trigger: Absolute-form URI with an empty path and query delimiter produces a zero-length copy with a NULL source.

defects.comment: The input creates a valid empty-path case that supplies NULL to a nonnull copy argument. UBSan reports the contract violation before any nonzero-size copy; the logs show no memory corruption.

classification.label: истинный дефект
classification.basis: The sanitizer repeatedly reports an invalid API argument; normal/optimized execution did not crash, but that does not invalidate the source-level contract violation.

remediation.recommended_action: Skip the copy for zero length or provide a valid non-NULL source for the empty URI case.

fixed_code_retest.result: Not applicable: neither a source fix nor a compensating measure has been applied. Existing non-sanitized and optimized replays use the unfixed code.

defects.module: nginx core DNS resolver (A, SRV and PTR answer processing)
defects.sanitizer_type: UBSan: signed left shift whose result cannot be represented in int (shift/signed integer overflow); no ASan report in this finding group

weakness_mapping.name: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
weakness_mapping.rationale: The signed shift result exceeds the range representable by int; the C operation therefore has undefined behavior.

input_vector.format: raw DNS wire response preceded by the IF07 mode byte
input_vector.trigger: The DNS answer TTL starts with 0xff; equivalent record paths also expose shifts while assembling an IPv4 address when its first octet is at least 0x80.

defects.comment: Input bytes are promoted to signed int before shifting. Values whose high byte is at least 0x80 exceed the signed range. Negative TTL values are clamped to zero; for address assembly the calculation uses the same unsafe signed-shift pattern. No out-of-bounds access or memory corruption was reported.

classification.label: истинный дефект
classification.basis: All 11,059 group artifacts reproduce the UBSan finding; plain replays exit normally. Undefined signed arithmetic is a real code defect even without a reproduced production crash.

remediation.recommended_action: Assemble wire-format values in an unsigned fixed-width type, with explicit conversions and tests for high-bit-set octets; preserve the intended TTL normalization semantics.

fixed_code_retest.result: Not applicable: neither a source fix nor a compensating measure has been applied. Existing plain replays use the unfixed code.

defects.module: nginx core DNS resolver (PTR response processing)
defects.sanitizer_type: UBSan: nonnull-attribute violation (NULL passed to an argument declared non-NULL); no ASan report in this finding group

weakness_mapping.name: Function Call with Incorrectly Specified Arguments
weakness_mapping.rationale: NULL is passed to ngx_strncmp/strncmp despite the nonnull argument contract. With zero length, no memory access is shown; CWE-476 is therefore not claimed.

input_vector.format: raw DNS wire response preceded by the IF07 mode byte
input_vector.trigger: A PTR response yields an empty decompressed name (name.len == 0 and name.data == NULL) while the harness has a matching pending PTR query.

defects.comment: The zero-length string is represented by a NULL data pointer and is passed to ngx_strncmp. UBSan enforces the function's nonnull contract; the recorded call compares zero bytes and the logs contain no NULL read/write or memory-corruption report.

classification.label: истинный дефект
classification.basis: The invalid argument is reproducibly detected by UBSan; absence of a plain-build crash does not make the contract violation a false positive.

remediation.recommended_action: Skip the comparison when name.len is zero or ensure empty names use a valid non-NULL sentinel before calling ngx_strncmp.

fixed_code_retest.result: Not applicable: neither a source fix nor a compensating measure has been applied. Existing plain replays use the unfixed code.
